given: New enquiry with all required current evidence and valid exact terms
expected_specification: Positive decision may authorize setup; activation also checks existing gates

given: Missing mandatory fact; named follow-up
expected_specification: Draft preserved; no setup authorization

given: Condition has owner due date and progression effect
expected_specification: Conditional persists; activation rejected

given: Prior conditional now fully resolved; fresh independent review and terms
expected_specification: Old condition retained; new decision can authorize

given: Entity classified under Accounting Law 4.1.2 with approved 8.3 conclusion
expected_specification: 8.1 not applicable only on approved basis; other rules still evaluated

given: Unknown framework/category; tenure history suggests limit
expected_specification: No assumed SME exception; hold pending classification

given: Full-IFRS client; applicable limit exceeded
expected_specification: Cannot waive applicable tenure prohibition

given: Replacement under 8.1; proposed return within applicable restriction
expected_specification: Hold/refuse affected positive action

given: SME client with unknown replacement basis
expected_specification: Reject inference; obtain specific 8.2 conclusion

given: This firm provided tax advice for the audited financial year
expected_specification: Prohibition once service/year facts established; approval not waiver

given: Valuation-only service with no tax/accounting facts
expected_specification: No current local 9.5 valuation ban inferred; ethical/service review still required

given: Different invoice year but service concerns audited year
expected_specification: Invoice date alone does not clear same-year service assessment

given: Unpaid invoice not yet due; local interpretation unresolved
expected_specification: Do not assert breach from nonzero balance; legal review holds affected clearance

given: Going-concern concern with documented professional response
expected_specification: Review matter; no automatic statutory ban

given: Low proposed fee/deadline concern; resources unproven
expected_specification: Review adequacy; no price threshold formula

given: Predecessor unreachable; permission/attempts/alternative steps documented
expected_specification: Reasoned applicable conclusion required; no automatic clean answer

given: Client refuses predecessor permission
expected_specification: Investigate and conclude; no copied clearance

given: Confirmed applicable prohibition; safeguard field completed
expected_specification: Rejected; safeguard text cannot waive prohibition

given: Mandatory relationship fact unknown
expected_specification: Rejected until resolved

given: Covered person conflict removable under applicable rule
when: Remove actual person and assess replacement
expected_specification: New clearance required; firm-wide rules remain

given: Expert worked for client four years ago in a different role
expected_specification: Reject blanket legal inference; qualified declaration/policy review

given: Only blank preprinted preparer/reviewer/partner names exist
expected_specification: Rejected; require actual attributable coverage

given: Yes to negative no-financial-interest assertion
expected_specification: Meaning is asserted absence; not a financial-interest disclosure

given: Yes only to check-performed question
expected_specification: Check completion is not substantive absence proof

given: Management refuses required access/responsibility
expected_specification: Apply precondition result; no unconditional positive decision

given: Imposed limit meets refusal condition; no compelling law
expected_specification: Rejected under applicable rule

given: Client must obtain an audit; this firm not compelled
expected_specification: Rejected; client obligation is insufficient

given: Exact statutory appointment compels auditor; specific review completed
expected_specification: Exception only for approved condition; no independence waiver

given: Prescribed framework unacceptable without safeguards/disclosures
expected_specification: Rejected; paragraph-specific analysis required

given: Agreement upload hash valid but signer authority unverified
expected_specification: Held; integrity of file is not authority/authenticity

given: Paper agreement missing evidence of applicable legal formalities
expected_specification: Manual legal validity unresolved; no activation

given: Electronic agreement with documented authority and valid signing evidence
expected_specification: Manual verification supported; do not claim provider verification

given: New period; old terms reviewed as unchanged with applicable local conclusion
expected_specification: Fresh period assessment/decision required; new letter not automatically mandatory

given: Lower assurance requested solely to avoid audit problem
expected_specification: Reject unjustified downgrade; consultation/withdrawal review

given: Material relationship change after acceptance
expected_specification: Hold affected continuation; preserve original decision; reassess

given: Terms evidence changes after positive decision
expected_specification: Stale decision rejected; re-review/reapprove

given: Cannot continue; legal ability to withdraw unknown
expected_specification: Record withdrawal_review; consult; no automatic external notices

given: Withdrawal authorized with documented obligations
expected_specification: Preserve file/history and attributable communication evidence

given: Decision expired
expected_specification: Rejected until current reviewed decision

given: Reviewer is same actor as preparer
expected_specification: Independent review requirement enforced

given: Applicable ethical edition unresolved
expected_specification: No silent selection; explicit applicability decision

given: Licence status unverified; credential file uploaded
expected_specification: Manual qualification required; upload alone not registry validation

given: Legacy record has no optional acceptance profile
expected_specification: Record compatibility path and P01 decision; no false claim that all gates run

given: Issued/sealed engagement; later adverse fact
